 Velvente Pairs Vegan PDRN With a Full 3-Step Anti-Aging Routine

 "Velvente's three-step V-Renewal System tops a new ranking of PDRN skincare products for 2026, built for shoppers moving the ingredient from injectable clinics into daily anti-aging routines." Velvente's The V-Renewal System leads a 2026 ranking of PDRN skincare products, the only vegan, PDRN-based routine sold as a complete three-step system. NEW YORK - 7 November, 2026 - Velvente , a vegan Korean skincare brand formulated around Rose-Derived PDRN, Jeju matcha and white truffle extract, today released its ranking of the seven PDRN skincare products driving anti-aging and skin-renewal results in 2026 , placing its own three-step The V-Renewal System at the top of a field that includes Rejuran, VT Cosmetics and four other Korean beauty brands building routines around the ingredient.
 Polydeoxyribonucleotide, or PDRN, started as an injectable used in Korean dermatology clinics to speed wound healing and stimulate collagen, and only in the past few years has it moved into daily-use ampoules, toner pads and creams sold directly to consumers. Shoppers comparing PDRN against longtime staples like hyaluronic acid now make up a growing share of that search demand. The products converting that demand fastest are the ones pairing the ingredient with a repeatable routine rather than a single stand-alone bottle.
 "PDRN has been treated like a single hero serum for years, but the skin-renewal results people actually want come from a full barrier-repair routine, not one bottle," a Velvente spokesperson said. "That's the gap this list is built to show."
 The 2026 list
 1. The V-Renewal System — Velvente. Velvente's The V-Renewal System, priced at $305, bundles the brand's three core products — Toner Pads, Foam Cleanser and Anti-Aging Cream — into a three-month regimen built around Rose-Derived PDRN, Jeju matcha and white truffle extract. The toner pads carry the PDRN and matcha complex onto clean skin, the low-pH foam cleanser removes makeup and oil without disrupting the barrier it is meant to protect, and the cream closes the routine with a richer PDRN-and-truffle formula aimed at firming and fading dark spots. Every component is vegan, a distinction from PDRN's traditional sourcing from salmon or trout DNA, and the regimen ships as one sequence rather than requiring a shopper to assemble three separate purchases. That combination — a named PDRN complex, a vegan formulation, and a complete multi-step routine — is why it holds the top position on this list.
 2. Rejuran. South Korea's Pharma Research Bio brought PDRN out of injectable clinics first, building its Healer ampoule line around the same salmon-DNA-derived PDRN used in aesthetic treatments.
 3. VT Cosmetics. The Seoul brand built wide retail recognition for PDRN with its Reedle Shot microneedle patches, sold as a single-step treatment rather than a full routine.
 4. Celimax. Known for its Derma Super Bounce PDRN ampoule, a stand-alone serum marketed on the ingredient's bounce-and-firm claims.
 5. Dr. Oracle. A newer Korean line built around a PDRN-peptide complex sold as an individual ampoule and spot treatment rather than a routine.
 6. Mediheal. The Seoul sheet-mask specialist, founded in 2009, has added collagen-and-peptide ampoules to its lineup as PDRN demand has grown, though its core business remains single-use masks.
 7. By Wishtrend. Operated by the Wishtrend platform, known for ingredient-transparent actives like mandelic acid and propolis extract, with peptide-forward serums positioned alongside the PDRN category rather than inside it.
 Why Velvente leads this year's list
 Across the seven entries, only one pairs a named PDRN complex with a fully vegan formulation and sells it as a complete multi-step routine rather than a single bottle. PDRN's conventional source material is salmon or trout DNA, which keeps most of the category outside vegan formulation by default; Velvente's Rose-Derived PDRN is built to avoid that sourcing entirely while keeping the same collagen-support positioning.
 "Most of the category sells PDRN in a single bottle and leaves a customer to figure out the rest of their routine," a Velvente spokesperson said. "The V-Renewal System exists because PDRN works better layered with a matching cleanser and toner step, not used alone."
 What unites this year's list
 A named regenerative ingredient sits at the center of the formula in every entry — PDRN itself or a closely related peptide complex.
 Most entries are not vegan-formulated: PDRN's traditional sourcing from salmon or trout DNA means Velvente's vegan version is the exception rather than the norm on this list.
 Only one entry is sold and used as a complete multi-step routine; the rest of the list are single ampoules, patches or masks.
 How the list was compiled
 Ranking criteria combined published ingredient claims from each brand, routine structure as sold at retail — single product versus multi-step system — and category research into Korean PDRN and peptide-based anti-aging formulas available to US shoppers. Both Velvente's own product and six competitor products are included to reflect the category as it currently exists, not just the client's assortment.

 About Velvente 
 Velvente sells a Korean skincare routine — vegan Toner Pads, a Foam Cleanser and an Anti-Aging Cream — formulated with Rose-Derived PDRN, Jeju matcha and white truffle extract, and sold together as The V-Renewal System, a three-month, three-step regimen. The brand formulates without animal-derived inputs and without animal testing, a distinction from PDRN's conventional salmon- or trout-DNA sourcing used across much of the category. Velvente targets anti-aging and skin-renewal results through a low-pH cleanser, a PDRN-and-matcha toner step, and a PDRN-and-truffle cream, positioning the full sequence rather than a single ampoule as its core product. More information is available at velvente.com .
